data.gender_notes: Mujeedah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ajdad', meaning 'to succeed, to be victorious'. In Islamic tradition, the name Mujeedah represents a person who is triumphant in life and overcomes all obstacles with determination and faith. The name Mujeedah carries the meaning “Successful, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mujeedah usually hope their child will grow to embody successful, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mujeedah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
